title: PDV Phase 20 Altmer crisis, Lorkhan, and favor implementation costing
designRules: Auri-El remains the foundation; secondary focus and alignment modify play but do not create generic broad worship.
Lorkhan pressure is authored and tagged, not ambient Skyrim existence.
Crisis states are player-readable and recoverable; they do not silently remove a patron.
Positive devotional upkeep must trend net-positive for normal Altmer play.
Vampire Altmer is terminal or exile-limited while cursed; werewolf hard-halts advancement.
Only one active contextual favor family should be loud at a time unless a later manifest explicitly widens that rule.

notes: Record-wired as a PDV_StateTrack on PDV__ManagerQuest through pdv-phase20-altmer-author.
ScarredResolved is memory, not an active punishment state.
Alignment gates interpretation, access, and Trinimac posture.
It is not a third steady boon package.

crisisSources.antiRepeat: first authored declaration only; later Dragonborn identity is scar/context, not repeated penalty
authored contradiction only; generic anti-Thalmor violence rejected
curated Companions or beast-form fork only

favorFamilies.rewardIntent: authority and discipline without generic violence

curseAndExileRules.title: Exile From The Dawn
curseAndExileRules.body: Auri-El is closed while you flee the sun. Still, an Altmer does not become nothing because the records cast them out. What remains is exile: a narrow discipline, a name kept privately, never a full return.
curseAndExileRules.requiredBehavior: block full orthodox restoration while cursed; allow exile-limited flavor only

curseAndExileRules.title: Exiled From The Dawn
curseAndExileRules.body: You are exiled from the dawn, not restored to it. A thin discipline remains, capped low, held only by refusal to collapse.
curseAndExileRules.requiredBehavior: recognition is scarred and conditional, not a clean replacement path

curseAndExileRules.title: The Project Inverted
curseAndExileRules.body: The whole of Altmer faith is to become spirit again. You have become a beast. There is no doctrine for this, no heresy small enough to hold it, no path in any direction. Devotion stops here.
curseAndExileRules.requiredBehavior: halt advancement instead of opening a rival viable Altmer path

rejectedHooks: ordinary friendship with Nords or non-Altmer
post-first-crisis Dragonborn identity as repeated penalty
vampire power as a clean devotion route

immersionProof.signaturePromise: Coherence is tested by Skyrim's Lorkhan-shaped world without punishing ordinary life.
diegeticTriggerMeaning: Lorkhan pressure fires only when an authored event forces an Altmer theological contradiction.
Dawn steadiness and orthodox costly enforcement read as Auri-El/coherence maintenance, not generic magic reward.
feedbackSurface: Crisis messages and StateLabels explain None, Dissonant, Questioning, Reasserting, and ScarredResolved.
Survey/status through GetAltmerSummary and quiet/marked favor copy tells the player whether pressure, recovery, or orthodoxy is active.
rejectedGenericBehavior: ordinary friendship with Nords or non-Altmer
post-first-crisis Dragonborn identity as repeated penalty
immersionProof.normalSessionFeel: A non-edge Altmer can study, practice dawn devotion, travel, and recover from one major crisis without hidden theological debt.
immersionProof.runtimePromotionGate: Before stronger Altmer rewards ship, prove one authored crisis, one daily-life positive loop, rejected ordinary surfaces, and recovery or scar readout.

rules: PDV_State_AltmerCrisis exists or the source has a tracked TODO-blocking assertion naming the missing record
manager source defines the crisis enum with the locked numeric values
record-wired Altmer favor families have KYWD, MGEF, and SPEL records and manager spell properties
all Altmer crisis, favor, curse, and Exiled vampire rows named in this manifest exist in PDV_RaceContent_Manifest.md
record-wired Altmer curse and Exiled vampire rows have MESG records and manager message properties
Lorkhan pressure routes only reference tagged/curated source families
record-wired Altmer trigger surfaces have ACTI records with PDV_EventSignalActivator, route IDs, origin gates, source IDs, and daily keys
Altmer trigger surfaces declare placementRefEditorId values and proof-placement-gate-live surfaces read back their QASmoke references
rejected hook strings are represented by verifier assertions or runtime negative cases before the slice is marked built
contextual favor logic exposes one active loud favor family unless the later implementation manifest explicitly widens this

positive: fresh Altmer can maintain net-positive devotion through dawn practice, study, and coherent behavior without perfect play
a first authored crisis source can enter Dissonant or Questioning and show the matching player-facing message
a coherent recovery route can move toward Reasserting or ScarredResolved without clearing patron piety
a focused-deity favor can fire from its intended hook family and remain readable in Survey/status
negative: ordinary travel and ordinary friendships do not apply Lorkhan pressure
generic spellcasting or raw magic skill gain does not trigger Magnus/Syrabane/Xarxes favor by itself
generic anti-Thalmor violence does not count as Talos contradiction or Trinimac civilization defense
post-first-crisis Dragonborn identity does not repeatedly penalize the player
vampire state does not become a stronger clean Altmer devotion route
